triplets.head: EN 1888 (pushchairs/prams)
triplets.tail: Specifies product safety requirements and test methods; does not specify outer packaging transport impact resistance, compression resistance, or anti-tip standards

triplets.head: EN 716 (travel cribs)
triplets.tail: Specifies product safety requirements; does not specify outer packaging transport impact resistance, compression resistance, or anti-tip standards

triplets.head: EN 13209-1 (framed carriers)
triplets.tail: Specifies product safety requirements; does not specify outer packaging transport standards

triplets.head: EN 13209-2 (soft carriers)
triplets.tail: Specifies product safety requirements; does not specify outer packaging transport standards

triplets.head: ECE R129 (child car seats)
triplets.tail: Specifies child restraint system safety in vehicles; does not specify outer packaging transport impact resistance, compression resistance, or anti-tip standards

triplets.head: EN 14988 (high chairs)
triplets.tail: Specifies product safety requirements; does not specify outer packaging transport standards

triplets.head: EN 71 (toys)
triplets.tail: Specifies mechanical, physical, flammability, and chemical safety of toys; does not specify outer packaging transport standards

triplets.head: EN 1400 (pacifiers)
triplets.tail: Specifies product safety requirements; does not specify outer packaging transport standards

triplets.head: EN 14350 (drinking equipment)
triplets.tail: Specifies product safety requirements for materials, structure, performance, and packaging information; does not specify transport-level outer packaging impact/compression/anti-tip standards

triplets.head: EU PPWR (Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation)
triplets.tail: Entered into force February 2025; regulates sustainability, recyclability and labelling of packaging for all products including baby gear, but does not mandate impact resistance, compression resistance, or anti-tip transport performance for outer packaging of baby travel gear specifically

triplets.head: EU baby product EN standards (EN 1888, EN 716, EN 13209, ECE R129, EN 14988, EN 71, EN 1400, EN 14350)
triplets.relation: whether they specify required impact resistance for outer packaging of baby travel gear
triplets.tail: These EN product safety standards regulate the finished product's structural safety, mechanical performance, and chemical composition — none of them contain provisions mandating specific impact resistance levels for the outer transport packaging of baby travel gear

triplets.head: EU baby product EN standards (EN 1888, EN 716, EN 13209, ECE R129, EN 14988, EN 71, EN 1400, EN 14350)
triplets.relation: whether they specify required compression resistance for outer packaging of baby travel gear
triplets.tail: These EN product safety standards do not contain provisions mandating specific compression resistance levels for the outer transport packaging of baby travel gear

triplets.head: EU baby product EN standards (EN 1888, EN 716, EN 13209, ECE R129, EN 14988, EN 71, EN 1400, EN 14350)
triplets.relation: whether they specify required anti-tip transport standards for outer packaging of baby travel gear
triplets.tail: These EN product safety standards do not contain provisions mandating specific anti-tip transport standards for the outer packaging of baby travel gear
